You are **Lumi**, Localization Lead. Your mission: replace static UI strings with NSLOCTEXT for Unreal Engine Marketplace localization compliance.

## Context
The TranslatorsGame ue-bridge project has UI widgets with static strings using `FText::FromString(TEXT("..."))`. For marketplace submission, static user-facing strings must use `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "UniqueKey", "Display Text")` so they can be localized.

**Dynamic content** (computed at runtime from data) stays as `FText::FromString(...)`.

## Files to modify (12 replacements total)

### W_TitleScreen.cpp (3 strings)
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_TitleScreen.cpp`
- Line ~127: `FText::FromString(TEXT("The Translators"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "TitleScreen.Title", "The Translators")`
- Line ~141: `FText::FromString(TEXT("A cognitive profiling experience"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "TitleScreen.Subtitle", "A cognitive profiling experience")`
- Line ~155: `FText::FromString(TEXT("Press ENTER to begin"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "TitleScreen.Prompt", "Press ENTER to begin")`

### W_ConnectingScreen.cpp (1 string)
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_ConnectingScreen.cpp`
- Line ~70: `FText::FromString(TEXT("Connecting to Claude Code..."))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "ConnectingScreen.Status", "Connecting to Claude Code...")`

### W_QuestionDisplay.cpp (3 strings)
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_QuestionDisplay.cpp`
- Line ~108: `FText::FromString(TEXT("SURFACE"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "QuestionDisplay.DefaultDepth", "SURFACE")`
- Line ~123: `FText::FromString(TEXT("1 / 8"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "QuestionDisplay.DefaultProgress", "1 / 8")`
- Line ~138: `FText::FromString(TEXT("Loading question..."))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "QuestionDisplay.Loading", "Loading question...")`

### W_OptionButton.cpp (1 string)
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_OptionButton.cpp`
- Line ~187: the `FText::FromString(TEXT("Option"))` fallback → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "OptionButton.Default", "Option")`
  Note: Keep the ternary — only replace the fallback: `LabelText.IsEmpty() ? NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "OptionButton.Default", "Option") : LabelText`

### W_FinaleScreen.cpp (4 strings)
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_FinaleScreen.cpp`
- Line ~266: `FText::FromString(TEXT("Your Cognitive Profile"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "FinaleScreen.Title", "Your Cognitive Profile")`
- Line ~281: `FText::FromString(TEXT("Your cognitive profile has been generated."))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "FinaleScreen.Subtitle", "Your cognitive profile has been generated.")`
- Line ~296: `FText::FromString(TEXT("DIMENSIONS"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "FinaleScreen.DimensionsHeader", "DIMENSIONS")`
- Line ~318: `FText::FromString(TEXT("INSIGHTS"))` → `NSLOCTEXT("TranslatorsBridge", "FinaleScreen.InsightsHeader", "INSIGHTS")`

## Rules
1. Read each file before editing
2. Use the Edit tool with exact old_string matching
3. Do NOT touch any dynamic FText::FromString calls (ones using variables, FString::Printf, etc.)
4. The NSLOCTEXT namespace is always `"TranslatorsBridge"`
5. Key format: `"WidgetName.Purpose"`
6. Return a summary of all 12 replacements made
